reference_source: Current protected fivebar stance/fk/link_frames, body to_robot RZ180, source turret MADE/bought frames and inspected original266 world STL vertices; independent of the renderer manifest.
tolerance_basis: Existing rendered-motion allowance in mm, fixed before current browser capture. Original266 binary STL coordinates are Float32; inverse-home localization and metre-scale Float32 buffers add rounding. The allowance covers those presentation transforms, not original CAD surface tessellation error or manufacturing tolerance.

shared_protocol.rigid_leg_scope: Both source upper/lower hinge chains, named link adapters/nuts and exact grouped screw partitions, source-declared five-bar loop closure, plus stationary housings/supports. Required input/dependent poses come from the existing shared loop protocol.
shared_protocol.complete_live_scope: All224 original logical parts/four source triangle partitions and actual source anchors at every live pose. Translate-only knee/apex representations use independently derived source-FK expectations; they are not called additional mechanically resolved hinge/rotor assemblies.
shared_protocol.turret_and_wheel_scope: Full existing shared range/interior/ancestor-child coverage for pan, tilt, pinion, dial, both flywheels, flap and both separate wheel tyres. All modelled/current effects are inventoried separately; firing/reset/stop/start and complete mode transitions add samples.

fault_controls: RZ180 replaced by reflection or zero rotation
7mm pivot offset with geometry compensated to keep home correct
lower-link parent lost while home world placement is preserved
stationary motor case attached to rotating upper link with home preserved
missing logical part or source partition triangle
held/failed/stale recorded request and repeated current-recorded-current
dispose during loading and late completion cannot attach
limits: A rendered presentation match does not qualify unresolved composite hub/motor internals, physical fastenings/interfaces, continuous paths/clearance, loads, support, drop/fall or print release. Original issue193 mechanical acceptance remains open. This is a frozen pre-capture corpus, not a capture or pass report.
